Following the announcement of positive VITESSE topline results on December 16, 2025, the warrants issued in connection with the March 2025 PIPE Financing were fully exercised, resulting in additional gross proceeds of $ 195.4 million (€ 166.7 million at the exchange rate of 1 EUR = $ 1.17 ), of which $ 100.7 million (€ 85.7 million) was received in the fourth quarter of 2025 and $ 94.7 million (€ 81.0 million) was received in January 2026.

Submission of BLA FDA for the VIASKIN® Peanut Patch in Children Aged 4-7 Years On September 29, 2026, the Company announced the submission of a BLA to FDA seeking approval of the VIASKIN® Peanut patch for the treatment of peanut allergy in children aged 4 through 7 years.

The FDA has 60 days from the submission date to determine whether the BLA is sufficiently complete to permit substantive review, following which the Company anticipates receipt of a Prescription Drug User Fee Act (“PDUFA”) target action date.

Additional financing completed during 2026 enabled further organizational expansion and commercial readiness, including third-quarter interactions with the FDA, the submission of the BLA for VIASKIN® Peanut in children ages 4 through 7 on September 29, 2026, and preparation for a potential commercial launch, if approved.

We have held discussions with the FDA on how to ensure a timely review of the BLA for Viaksin Peanut for toddlers aged 1 through 3 years following the recent submission of the BLA for Viaskin Peanut for children 4 through 7 years old, including a potential rolling submission of the 1-through-3 BLA.

It would provide us and FDA the opportunity to align on the form, content, and best timing of the components of the submission of the BLA for Viaskin Peanut for 1 through 3 year olds, in support of an efficient review of both BLAs.

We will continue the regulatory dialogue with FDA over the next few months and expect to submit the BLA for Viaskin Peanut in toddlers 1 through 3 years old in 2027, and we expect to will provide further update once the regulatory pathway for our toddler program has been finalized.
